findings.evidence: Before the patch, a synthetic timeout in creation-time validate_only returned META_REMOTE_RESULT_AMBIGUOUS with reconciliation_required=true even when ledger_events and created objects were empty. A dependent validation timeout likewise left only the previously completed campaign recorded, not an ambiguous child step.
findings.precision: The remote-creation ambiguity flag was false operational reporting; it did not actually create an AMBIGUOUS child row. The review overstated this as a permanently ambiguous row. The proven defect was the recovery instruction and HTTP contract.
findings.change: Classify validation timeout before prepare_passo as META_VALIDATE_TIMEOUT, preserve prior durable operation keys, permit retry of the same approval through the ledger, and return HTTP 504 without reconciliation_required. Creation POST timeout remains ambiguous and non-retriable.
findings.tests: Eight new regressions cover validation timeouts at all four object types, no reservation/ambiguity for the unsubmitted step, current partial receipt, HTTP 504, exact same-approval recovery with only four creation POSTs overall, genuine creation ambiguity, and duplicate-key rejection.
